batting.name: ST Jayasuriya
batting.dismissal: c Pankaj Singh b SK Trivedi

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: st Kamran Akmal b SK Warne

batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c NK Patel b Sohail Tanvir

batting.name: SM Pollock
batting.dismissal: c Kamran Akmal b Sohail Tanvir

batting.name: SA Asnodkar
batting.dismissal: c YV Takawale b CRD Fernando

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c A Nehra b CRD Fernando

batting.name: SR Watson
batting.dismissal: c SR Tendulkar b RR Raje

balls.text: and again! Takawale's blitzed 25 off the last over, the last ball is a full toss just outside off stump, Takawale backs away and slices the ball in the air over point for four more
he's found the boudnary again! The length is full this time and Takawale makes room and throws his bat at it, the top edge flies over the keeper to the boundary, what a finish for Mumbai
the length is too short outside off stump, Takawale makes room by moving towards leg and cuts the ball in the air over backward point for four more, this is the most expensive over of the innings
Takawale's hit the first six of the innings! Takawale backs away to make room, waits for the slower ball and hits it with power over the long-off boundary, mid-off was in the circle
short of a length angling into middle stump, pulled through midwicket
another short ball, Takawale backs away to make room and chips it over the keeper, third man is very fine so the ball is cut off, that's a no-ball for the second bouncer of the over
Watson starts off with a bouncer, Takawale tries to pull and he gets a top edge over the keeper for a streaky boundary
another ball in the blockhole outside off, the batsman digs it out on the off side
Takawale lofts the ball inside out but it falls short of the fielder at deep cover

caught! Tanvir picks up number four with a slower ball outside off stump, Smith backs away to make room and lofts the ball straight to Niraj Patel on the long-off boundary, that's Tanvir's 21st wicket in the tournament, he's three clear of Sreesanth in second place
Takawale gets smacked on the pad by one that angles sharply into him from outside off stump
bowled him! Tanvir goes a touch wider of the crease and fires the yorker in, the ball homes into the base of leg stump and uproots it once Pandey fails to bring his bat down quickly enough
Pandey comes forward and digs out the yorker from middle stump back to the bowler, not much he or anyone can do with that
a slower ball at 118 kmh outside off stump, Smith tries to cut but gets beaten by the change of pace
bowled full down leg side, that's a wide
Smith gets down on one knee and lofts the slower ball towards wide long-on for four, he cleared his front foot out of the way to make room and used his power to good effect
cut off the back foot towards deep point for two more, Watson fires the throw back in
Pandey backs away towards leg and hits the ball off a good length towards long-on with a flat bat
the slower ball on middle and leg. Smith moves forward too early and has to wait for the ball and nudge it on the leg side
short of a length on middle and leg, Pandey moves across and flicks off his hips towards deep backward square
Tanvir bowls the slower yorker which Pandey digs out towards mid-on for the quick single
a full delivery angles into the right-hander once again, Pandey strides forward and drives towards the off side

Pollock's gone first ball! Tanvir pitches the ball on a good length around off stump from round the wicket and seams the ball away from the right-hander after angling it into him, Pollock fends at the ball off the back foot and edges it to Akmal who dives to his right to hold the catch

he's given him lbw! Tanvir bowls the slower ball from over the wicket, angling into the left-hander, Nayar tries to pull the ball while getting down on one knee, he misses and gets hit on the back foot, that's plumb unless there was an inside edge, Hariharan answers a vociferous appeal with the finger
Nayar tries to pull but is too early on the shot and doesn't make proper contact
full ball angling into the off stump, driven off the front foot towards mid-off
bowled flat and fast outside off , Nayar cuts towards point off the back foot
Warne bowls a bouncer! and it's too high, fantastic work by Akmal to collect it
defended on the front foot to the leg side, the ball goes into the massive gap in the infield and the batsmen run two
Nayar moves back and cuts a short ball to the cover point boundary, Mumbai reach 100, it's the slowest of the tournament

huge appeal for lbw, Smith strides forward to the slider that pitches on off stump and goes straight through, Smith tries to defend but gets hit on the pad in front of off stump, that's close and Warne isn't pleased at all

Uthappa's gone! He charges down the track far too early, Warne sees him coming and rips the leg break wide outside off stump, Uthappa swings wildly and helplessly but misses as the ball spins away from him, Akmal collects the ball wide outside off and does well to break the stumps before Uthappa regains his ground
Nayar steps out of his crease and swings hit bat hard to hit the ball towards deep midwicket, he didn't time it well for he wasn't to the pitch of the ball
Uthappa charges but gets beaten by a flat ball targeted at his pads, he tries to flick behind square but gets hit on the pad, the ball rolls towards short fine leg
Nayar steps out of his crease, Yusuf bowls a flatter and shorter one, Nayar works the ball through midwicket for a single
Uthappa moves on to the back foot and nudges the ball off his pads behind square leg for one
fuller length but the trajectory is flat on off stump, Nayar drives off the front foot through cover
Uthappa moves across his stumps to flick but gets hit on the pad by a flat and fast ball, they run a risky leg bye
Nayar cuts the ball firmly off the back foot to deep point
driven off the pads through the gap between midwicket and mid-on for two
Uthappa tries to sweep once again but gets a top edge over the keeper
loud appeal for lbw but Bowden says not out, Uthappa gets a large stride forward while trying to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pad, that would have missed off
Nayar tries to hit through the off side again but doesn't find the gap this time
Nayar makes room by moving towards leg and drives the slightly short ball through the off side, smart short and excellent placement
Nayar strides forward and pushes the ball into the massive gap at midwicket for two runs, all the fielders are on the boundary on the leg side
another short ball, it's a touch slower as well, Uthappa tries to pull again but misses once more
short of a length but down leg side, Uthappa pulls but misses

caught and bowled! Trivedi pitches the slower ball on a perfect length in line with the stumps, Tendulkar moves forward and closes the face of the bat too early while trying to flick, the leading edge flies right back to the bowler who takes a sharp catch on his follow through
full length outside off stump, Nayar drives the ball through cover point off the front foot, Watson fields in the deep
fuller length angling into middle stump, Tendulkar stays in his crease and punches the ball down the ground, just the single this time to long-on
fuller length on off stump, Nayar tries to drive but inside-edges on to his pad
good length from Trivedi but it doesn't matter, Nayar plants his front foot forward and hits the ball over the bowler's head with a flat bat
Nayar pushes the ball off the front foot into the yawning gap at midwicket, Warne runs across to field the ball
Nayar strides forward and defends towards the bowler
Tendulkar was beginning to come forward but eventually moved back to a flat ball on middle and nudged it towards square leg
Nayar strides forward and nudges a flighted leg break towards square leg for a single
fuller ball on middle stump, Tendulkar comes forward and closes the face of the bat to play the ball through midwicket
Tendulkar steps out of his crease but gets beaten by the length and has to defend in the end, Warne saw him coming

His luck's run out! Jayasuriya gets on to the front foot and tries to pull a short of a length delivery, he doesn't connect properly and the ball flies straight to Pankaj at midwicket who takes a simple catch on the edge of the circle
that's lucky again, Jayasuriya drives at a full ball outside off and the outside edge runs past the keeper for four runs

Jayasuriya's very lucky! He backs away and slogs at a good length ball on the stumps, he gets a top edge that flies right over the keeper's head and falls safe, the ball's not coming on to the bat at all
full ball nearly in the block hole outside off stump, Jayasuriya stays in his crease and drives the ball firmly through cover
the slower ball at 105 kmh on off and middle stump, Tendulkar waits for it and pushes towards midwicket
Tendulkar moves forward and across and tries to paddle the ball on the leg side, he gets hit on the pad for leg byes
bowled flat and fast outside off stump, that fizzed through on Jayasuriya who tried to cut but was beaten
flighted delivery on middle stump, Tendulkar stays in his crease, moves his front foot out of the way and hits the ball along the ground through midwicket, he was perhaps looking for the big hit
flat delivery on leg and middle, Jayasuriya moves across his stumps and pulls the ball down to fine leg
that's too short on middle stump, Jayasuriya gauges the pace well, waits for the ball and pulls it off the back foot into the gap at deep square leg
bowled flatter through the air, Tendulkar pushes the ball towards square leg
Tendulkar moves across his stump to nudge a tossed up delivery from outside leg stump past the wicketkeeper, short fine leg runs to his right and cuts it off
Tendulkar tries to make room by moving towards leg and nudges the ball towards the leg side for one
Jayasuriya moves across his stumps and tries to pull, the ball is a slower one and the bounce is low, Jayasuriya misses and gets hit on the pad outside off stump
Tendulkar moves across his stumps and paddles a ball from off behind square leg
cut off the back foot towards deep cover for one more
the ball keeps very low outside off and has no pace on it, Jayasuriya swings too early and misses
short and wide outside off stump, Tendulkar cuts off the back foot to deep cover, he missed out there
a bit too short from round the wicket, Jayasuriya moves back and across to pull but gets an inside edge on to the pad, whoops replays show no edge, that looks pretty close
Tendulkar waits on the back foot and cuts a flat ball from outside off stump wide of the fielder at short fine leg, Jayasuriua scampers through to the danger end
played off the front foot towards cover, tight bowling this
Tendulkar moves forward and pushes the ball towards midwicket
Jayasuriya moves forward and across and pushes the ball towards long-on
Jayasuriya moves across and nudges a flat ball off his pads towards midwicket
Tendulkar strides forward and nudges the ball gently into the wide open spaces at mid-on, the bowler has to run and fetch it so the batsmen run a comfortable two

the cheeky shot nearly goes wrong! Jayasuriya moves towards the off side to get inside the line of the ball and tries to scoop it over short fine leg, he doesn't get hold of it but the ball falls safely

massive! Jayasuriya moves across his crease and pulls a good length delivery from just outside off over the bowler's head, that wasn't a bad ball at all but it bounced only once before going over the straight boundary
Tendulkar strides forward to a good length ball and punches the delivery through cover for a single
Jayasuriya gets cramped for room with the angle into him and inside-edges the ball towards the leg side

what a shot that is, the length was on the shorter side but the line was slanting across the left-hander, Jayasuriya stands in his crease and flat-bats the ball over mid-off for four, that bounced twice before going over
the length is slightly shorter on middle stump, Jayasuriya moves back and nudges the ball towards mid-on, Yusuf concedes one off the over
Jayasuriya strides forward and defends back to the bowler
bowled flat and quick on off stump, defended on the front foot
Jayasuriya waits on the back foot and cuts towards point
defended off the front foot towards cover
big shout for lbw, Jayasuriya tries to hit Yusuf across the line but gets beaten by the low bounce and gets hit on the pad, that was missing leg
Tendulkar stays in his crease and works a good length ball that angles into him towards Watson at square leg
that's too full and far down leg side, Tendulkar doesn't connect with the flick and it's called wide
the line is fractionally on leg stump which allows Tendulkar to move back and nudge the ball off his pads through midwicket
Tendulkar sets off for the single after pushing the ball to mid-on but then decides against it, he called early enough and Jayasuriya gets back well in time
this time he moves back in his crease to give himself more time to flick a good length ball towards square leg, Watson throws at the stumps and concedes two over-throws
shot! shot! Tendulkar leans forward to a delivery that is slightly over-pitched and punches the ball with a perfectly straight bat to the long-on boundary, splendid stroke
Jayasuriya tries to blast a good length ball down the ground but gets an inside edge through midwicket, he hasn't timed it well and Patel pulls it in just inside the boundary
Tendulkar strides forward and drives a good length ball towards cover, just one run off the over, Mumbai are still in second gear
that's short and wide outside off stump, the bounce is a little low which is what beats Tendulkar's attempted cut through point, this pitch has been keeping low so far
that's a slower ball which keeps a little low outside off stump, Tendulkar stays in his crease and defends, the ball hits the toe end of the bat
tight line and length, in the channel outside off stump, Tendulkar tries to push off the front foot towards the off side but mis-times it back to the bowler
Jayasuriya comes half-forward and tries to hit a good length ball from outside off stump down the ground, he gets an outside edge towards third man for a single
Jayasuriya doesn't have any room to work with because Watson is keeping the ball close to off stump, he defends on the back foot to cover
Tendulkar moves forward and drives the ball into the gap between midwicket and mid-on
fuller ball on the pads, Tendulkar flicks the ball off the front foot and this time Trivedi makes an awful hash of it on the deep square leg boundary

that's just a bit short and a bit wide outside off stump, Jayasuriya moves back in his crease and cuts the ball towards deep point where Trivedi covers good ground and releases the ball quickly to keep the batsmen to just one
Tendulkar moves on to the front foot and steers a short of a length ball behind point towards third man for a single
pitches on a good length around off stump and slants across the right-hander, Tendulkar lets it go through to Akmal
Jayasuriya comes forward and drives a fuller ball hard and in the air towards Yusuf at mid-off, that is hit flat and the ball bounces just short of the fielder

that's wide outside off stump and the ball keeps low on Tendulkar who stretches and tries to cut the ball, the ball passes under his bat, Tendulkar looks at the umpire hoping for a wide but that's the end of the over
fuller length and the line is closer to the right-hander, angling into off stump, Tendulkar strides forward and blocks with bat and pad close together
excellent length and line, Watson pitches on a good length and seams the ball away from the right-hander, Tendulkar watches it closely off the back foot and pulls his bat out of the way
Watson pitches on leg and middle, Jayasuriya moves across and tries to flick off his pads but gets an inside edge on to pad, they run a single behind square
that was close, Jayasuriya neither goes forward nor back and in the end he checks his cut shot and the ball lobs over the in-field at cover, that ball stopped on him

that's a better line and length, Watson pitches on middle and off and slants the ball across the left-hander, Jayasuriya lets it go watchfully, the length didn't allow him any time to go on to the back foot either
that's too short and extremely wide outside off stump, the ball keeps a little low as well and bounces another time before reaching Akmal
Jayasuriya comes forward and nudges another good length ball into the gap between midwicket and mid-on, he will keep strike
fuller length and the angle into Jayasuriya from just outside off stump does not allow him room to free his arms, he leans on to the front foot and drives to mid-on
Tanvir's given away a run by spraying it wide outside off stump, Jayasuriya slashes but misses
Tanvir pitches on a good length and skids it through to Akmal after Jayasuriya lets it go on the front foot
tight line and length around off stump once again, Jayasuriya gets behind the line on the back foot and blocks
good length delivery with some swing into the left-hander, cramping Jayasuriya for room, he gets on to the front foot and defends on the off side

a full delivery swings into the left-hander from off stump, Jayasuriya moves forward and across his stumps and tries to flick, he misses and the ball hits the pad, Tanvir appeals but the ball was slipping down leg

Rajasthan have won! The tension got to Mumbai and they couldn't cope! Patel tried to pull the ball and mis-timed it towards the bowler, Fernando should have stopped it but he couldn't get down in time, the ball went towards mid-on where Smith fielded and threw the ball to the bowler's end, Jadeja was struggling to make his ground but Jasyasuriya failed to collect the ball cleanly and affect the run out, amazing scenes of celebration as the Rajasthan players mob Patel
Fernando's fired a wide down leg side, can you believe it, it's very far down leg side, unbelievable scenes
full ball on off stump, Jadeja chops the ball down to third man, they sprint hard for the single but they wont' get any more than that
that's a full toss on off stump, played to point off the back foot, they steal a single, they will run for anything

it's a six! Patel has cleared his front foot out of the way and lofted a full ball high over long-on for six, Fernando was looking for the block hole and didn't get the length right, Patel got under it and hit it with a lot of power

Jadeja backs away towards leg side but Fernando follows him and cramps him for room, he gets an inside edge past the keeper and the ball runs to the boundary where Nehra sprints and dives full length to his left and saves one run, spectacular effort
full ball on off stump, Patel tries to hit over the leg side but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg, he was lucky it didn't hit his stumps, unlucky that it didn't beat the fielder

another full ball outside off stump, Patel drives firmly off the front foot towards wide long-off where Nehra scampers to his right to field, there's an overthrow at the bowler's end and they run the third
another low full toss angling into the left-hander and Jadeja can't put it away, he hits it to midwicket
that's right up there in the block hole on off stump, dug out to point off the back foot, these two have added 50 for the 6th wicket
full ball outside off stump, Patel drives the ball firmly towards long-off where Nehra runs to his left and dives to save the boundary
a low full toss and Patel swings the ball to deep backward square leg for two more
Jadeja heaves across the line of a good length ball and mis-times it to midwicket,  Raje had over-stepped so there's a free hit coming up
that's the first six of the innings! Jadeja makes room by moving towards leg and lofts a full ball inside out over cover, that's a flat hit and he's cleared the boundary with ease
Patel backs away towards leg to make room but Nehra follows him with the yorker, Patel gets beaten but tries to steal the bye, Takawale collects the ball quickly and prevents it
full delivery nearly into the block hole, Jadeja tries to hit down the ground but mis-times it
bowled full into the block hole on middle stump, Patel uses the angle into him to work the ball to Thornely at deep square leg
another one! Nehra drifts on to the pads with fine leg in the circle, Patel gets hit on the pad and the ball runs to fine leg for four leg byes

Nerha fires one into the blockhole but the line is slightly down leg side, Patel gets an inside edge past the fielder at short fine leg for four, Rajasthan need several more of those, fours that is, not inside edges
too full on middle stump, Jadeja flicks the ball firmly off his pads but can't find the gap at deep backward square leg
full in the block hole outside off stump once again, driven off the front foot towards cover, Raje's bowled a disciplined over
another full ball in the block hole, Patel pushes the ball towards point from his crease and runs frantically for one
a full toss outside off stump, that's a loose ball but Patel drives it to the fielder in the deep where a mis-field allows the second
another super yorker in the block hole, Jadeja squeezes it towards third man for only a single
Patel makes a bit of room and drives a full ball towards long-off for a single
Raje begins his over with an outstanding yorker from round the wicket, Patel defends on the off side
Jadeja tries to pull but the length isn't short enough, he mis-hits the ball towards the bowler, another good over for Mumbai, only seven off it
Patel tries to drive down the ground, Fernando bowls a full ball in the block hole and Patel gets an inside edge to fine leg
Jadeja taps the ball off the back foot and sprints the single even though the ball went straight to Pandey at point
short of a length on middle and leg, Patel moves towards leg and works the ball off his pads through square leg
short of a length ball gets big on Patel who moves back and plays the ball towards cover, Jadeja wants the single but Patel sends him back
that's a length ball and Patel stands in his crease and launches the ball over mid-off, that's superbly timed and he's begun the over with a boundary
spot on length and line from Pollock on middle stump, the batsman taps the ball towards cover and runs the single, only five off the over
Jadeja waits on the back foot and opens the face to guide the ball towards third man
Patel moves back and drives towards long-on for a single
the slower ball at 111 kmh on middle and off, Jadeja pushes the ball towards point and immediately calls for the single
tight line and length on middle stump, Patel opens the face and plays the ball behind point
good length delivery angles across the left-hander, Patel cuts towards point
fuller length outside off stump, Jadeja moves forward and drives firmly through cover
steered with an open face towards third man for a single
good length delivery on middle and off stump, defended off the front foot towards point
short of  a length on off stump, Jadeja tries to cut but gets beaten
pushed off the front foot through the gap between cover and point
played off the back foot towards backward point
driven through cover for a single
Jadeja charges down the pitch and lofts Jayasuriya towards long-on, he hit it with the bottom of the bat
defended on the front foot toward the legs die
Jadeja begins to give Jayasuriya the charge but has to defend once he isn't to the pitch of the ball
Jadeja strides forward to a quicker ball and defends
bowled flat and full on middle stump, Patel flicks off the front foot towards deep square leg

Tendulkar's held on to a blinder! Watson gets on to the front foot and tries to pull a delivery that isn't short enough, he gets a top edge towards the vacant mid-on region because the fielder is on the boundary, Tendulkar however sprints across from midwicket, he just about reaches the ball and then dives and slides while holding on to a superb catch, he is pumped after taking it!
Watson tries to open the face and run a good length ball towards third man but gets beaten
good length and length on off stump, defended back to the bowler

there's a mix-up and Kaif is run out! Watson begins to play the pull but gets beaten by the slower one outside off, he re-adjusts and taps the ball awkwardly towards short third man, Kaif begins to charge down the pitch for the single but Watson is unsure, Watson then begins to run but changes his mind again, by this time Kaif is far down the pitch and Jayasuriya throws the ball to Raje who breaks the stumps with Kaif not even in the picture, Watson was watching the ball and not his partner
defended off the front foot towards the off side for one more

now how has that missed the stumps? Kaif moved forward to defend, the ball pitched on a good length and cut the batsman in half, it went over the top of middle and beat the keeper as well, mighty close
Kaif waits on the back foot and pushes a flat delivery towards long-on for a single,  only five of Jayasuriya's first over
bowled full angling into middle stump, Watson drives off the front foot towards long-on
pushed off the front foot towards extra cover
Kaif nudges the ball off his pads towards square leg for a risky single, the over-throw at the bowler's end allows the second
slower ball, Kaif comes out of his crease and gets an inside edge on to the pad
bowled flat and fast into the right-hander from round the wicket, defended off the front foot on the leg side
played towards third man for a single

good length delivery outside off stump, Kaif moves back and opens the face late to play the ball behind point, there's a chance of a run out at the batsman's end as they run the second but the throw goes to the wrong end
the slower ball bowled full on middle stump, Watson nudges the ball off his pads towards midwicket
too full once again on middle and leg, Watson lofts the ball off his pads high over square leg, the ball bounces just inside the boundary
too full outside off stump, Watson leans forward and drives the ball hard towards mid-off where the fielder dives over the ball and lets it go through for four, he should have stopped that
Kaif cuts a good length from from outside off towards third man
nudged off the front foot towards long-on for a single
Watson moves across his stumps and cuts the ball late towards third man, deft touch
the slower ball on of stump, defended back to the bowler on the front foot
that's too wide outside off stump, Kaif stands in his crease and cuts the ball through point for a single
Watson mis-times the drive off the back foot towards long-on
short of a length outside off, driven off the back foot towards the off side
Fernando's searching for the block hole but doesn't quite find it, Kaif leans across his stumps and pushes the ball on the leg side
Kaif nudges the ball towards midwicket off the front foot
bowled fast down leg side, that's another wide, Mumbai have bowled a few of them today

that's a massive shout for lbw! Fernando bowls the quicker ball, pitches around off and angles it into the right-hander, Watson moves across and tries to flick but misses, that's pretty plumb, it hit him in front of middle
Fernando bowls the slower ball on a good length and angles it into the right-hander, Watson defends off the front foot
full length on middle and leg, Kaif flicks the ball off his pads towards long leg

caught! Asnodkar gets squared up by a good length ball that pitches around off and straightens off the pitch, he tries to push off the front foot and gets an outside edge, Takawale was initially going the wrong way but he dives quickly to his right to hold the catch with one hand
played late off the back foot towards third man
Asnodkar makes use of the width outside off stump to cut the ball past Pandey at point, Raje dive son the boudnary but can't save the four
Asnodkar tries to cut the ball but misses, that was too close to him
the length is a little shorter and the bounce is low, Watson tries to defend but gets an outside edge behind point for one
too full outside off stump, Watson strides forward and drives the ball with impeccable timing through extra cover for four, superb shot
tight line and length on off and middle, worked off the pads towards square leg for a single
Asnodkar gets an inside edge that rolls behind square for a single
a bit too full this time, Fernando was looking for the yorker, Watson drives off the front foot towards Uthappa at mid-on for a single
excellent length on off and middle stump, Watson moves forward and pushes the ball towards extra cover
full and straight from Fernando, Watson gets behind the line and defends towards the bowler
banged in short but the line is down leg side, the umpire calls it wide
a good length ball skids on to Asnodkar who moves back and gets hit on the pad

he's struck first ball! Fernando bowls a full and slower ball, Yusuf chips the ball high in the air towards Nehra at mid-on who takes a few steps back to get into position, he juggles the ball once, and then once more as Mumbai's stomachs lurch and finally holds on to the catch
tight line and length on off stump, Asnodkar defends off the back foot towards the off side
slower ball outside off stump, Asnodkar tries to loft down the ground but gets an outside edge over point for two more
Asnodkar waits for the good length ball and opens the face of the bat at the last moment to run the ball past the keeper for four
Yusuf swings a good length ball off his pads to deep midwicket

dropped! Fernando floors an absolute sitter! Asnodkar tries to loft Pollock down the ground but mis-hits the ball at head height to mid-on, Fernando is on the edge of the circle and he muffs the simplest of chances, terrible fielding
Asnodkar charges down the track and swings wildly at a short of a length delivery, he misses it by miles
Pollock strays down leg side this time and Bowden signals wide after Asnodkar misses the leg glance
Asnodkar guides the ball down to third man to end the over
Asnodkar cuts the ball hard but straight to the fielder at point, there's a mix-up between the batsmen but the fielder doesn't hit at the bowler's end
Nehra strays far down leg side this time, that's a wide
Asnodkar plants his front foot forward and tries to hoick a good length ball, which pitches just outside off stump and angles into him, over midwicket, he misses and gets an inside edge on to the pad
fuller length angling into middle stump, nudged off the pads towards square leg for one more
driven hard off the front foot towards Nehra

Akmal's run out! A good length delivery angles into the right-hander, Asnodkar opens the face of the bat and runs the ball towards backward point, he calls for the single and Akmal responds, Manish Pandey picks up cleanly and throws down the stumps at the batsman's end, Akmal is worried about the ball hitting him and jumps as he enters his crease, as a result his bat was in the air although it was over the line, that is  shocking bit of running and Akmal has paid for it
another one! Akmal comes on to the front foot and drives a length delivery on the up through extra cover for four more, he's given the Rajasthan innings some momentum
that's a bit too full and straight, Akmal takes a step forward and flicks the ball in the air over midwicket for four
Asnodkar taps the ball towards midwicket and runs a very risky single, the fielder under-arms the throw at the bowler's end and had he hit it would have been close as well
Akmal punches the ball towards Jayasuriya at mid-off and sprints the single, a direct hit at the bowler's end and he would have been out
Akmal steps out of his crease and tries to pull a good length ball from way outside off stump through midwicket, the ball keeps low and beats the bat
Asnodkar moves across his stumps and nudges a good length ball towards square leg, that was Asnodkar's first ball by the way
pace and bounce from Nehra, Akmal tries to launch him into the stands at wide long-on but misses, that was a rather ambitious shot
Nehra gets the ball to swing into the right-hander's off stump, Akmal drives hard and hits the ball towards cover point
the good length ball swings into the right-hander from round the wicket, Akmal gets behind the line and punches towards cover
